name: Shipping Return
script:
# Run only for return invoices
if doc.is_return:

    # 1️⃣ Remove shipping rule
    doc.shipping_rule = None
    doc.delivery_charges = 0

    # 2️⃣ If taxes exist, keep ONLY first row
    if doc.taxes and len(doc.taxes) > 1:

        first_tax = doc.taxes[0]

        # Clear all taxes
        doc.set("taxes", [])

        # Re-add ONLY first row
        new_tax = doc.append("taxes", {})
        new_tax.charge_type = first_tax.charge_type
        new_tax.account_head = first_tax.account_head
        new_tax.description = first_tax.description
        new_tax.rate = first_tax.rate
        
        new_tax.cost_center = doc.cost_center or frappe.db.get_value(
            "Company", doc.company, "cost_center"
        )

    # 3️⃣ Recalculate totals
    doc.run_method("calculate_taxes_and_totals")
